_about: Shared fixtures for skills/build-item/scripts/review-gate.py, git-free (numstat, tree, mergeBase and config supplied). For each case, write each `receipts` entry to <tmp>/<its head>.json under the CASE's head filename (the request's head), pass receiptsDir=<tmp>, run `check`; `expect` is the answer minus `reason`. An `errors` case must exit 2 with one review-gate: line containing `contains`. A `record` case runs `record` with receiptsDir=<tmp>; with `refuses` null it must exit 0 and `check` on the same head with the second `cases` entry's config and over-limit numstat (the record request's head, tree and merge base) must then answer reviewed with that case's mergeBody. Tooling that re-implements the gate, or calls it, should run these against the installed script. A `round` case pipes {engines} into `round`: `expect` is its answer, or with `refuses` it must exit 2 with that text. An `engine` case writes `output` (null: no file) to a file, adds outputFile, runs `engine` and compares `expect`.
